notes.title: The Triptych is almost complete!
notes.content:
🎶🎺Hear ye, hear ye!🎺🎶 Death of the Reprobate, the third and final instalment of the Immortal John Triptych, will be released on November 7th 2024!

It's been a long old 4-and-a-bit years. I am withered to a husk. But it's almost done. Death of the Reprobate will finally come to Steam on November 7th 2024! Praise your lord and sharpen your sword, it's time for another Renaissanc-y adventure! (there's actually no sword in this one, but that line was slick so I'm going with it) GET IT ON YOUR WISHLISTS!

[previewyoutube=X3ql6wnJwT8;full][/previewyoutube]

I love you.

Joe

notes.title: Death of the Reprobate Demo - Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41244835/5be1dadab60d721b50d2e4dc576815af6c5c4092.png[/img]

The title says it all really. I made a little demo for Death of the Reprobate and it's available for the next week as part of Next Fest. This demo is unfortunately only available for Windows, and is not yet translated into any of the proposed additional languages. Otherwise it's basically a slightly janky version of the first couple of puzzles in the game, with a few snarky meta demo comments thrown in for good measure.

You can download the demo now on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1739900/Death_of_the_Reprobate/]store page[/url].

And you can let me know what you thought in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1739900/discussions/0/4204742074616575687/]community forum[/url].

Please don't hate it.

Thank you.

notes.title: Murder Your Foes in 4 New Languages!
notes.content:
Bonjour, Hola, Olá and Hallo! 

The Procession to Calvary now includes French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese and German subtitles. This update also adds an optional text background to improve readability, and fixes the 'two books' bug from the Mac a Linux builds. Hopefully it doesn't also break a bunch of stuff at the same time. 

Fingers crossed!

:)

Joe

notes.title: Trading Cards!
notes.content: Do you like Trading Cards? Cos' if you like Trading Cards I have some good news for you vis-à-vis Trading Cards - The Procession to Calvary (previously devoid of Trading Cards) now features Trading Cards!! What a lovely day for fans of Trading Cards!

notes.title: Happy Birthday to The Procession to Calvary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34988740/84b2f7d4e37b37f5dc26a1587abd29e993749346.gif[/img]

The Procession to Calvary is 1 year old today! We have a huge celebration planned, including a new patch, a GIANT GIVEAWAY and... Wait... Where's the cake? Did you bring the cake? Dude, you were supposed to bring the cake! 

I did EVERYTHING! Do you have ANY IDEA how long this GIF took to render!? I can't believe you forgot the cake! The ONE THING I asked you to do!

I've had enough of this! Forget the dang party! SPIT OUT THAT VOL-AU-VENT!

There will be no DLC for you. And you can forget about the nauseatingly upbeat, 24 hour livestream of me playing the 'The Golden Age Adventure Games That Inspired Me'.

You're getting nothing.

P.S.

The 40% discount has already started, so I can't cancel that, but I would ask that you don't make use of it. 

You  haven't earned it.

notes.title: The Procession to Calvary is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Huzzah!

The time is finally upon us! The Procession to Calvary is now available for you to purchase on Steam, with a 10% discount for the next week. 

Dust off your inventories and sharpen your sabres, it's time for a new adventure!

If you haven't yet played Four Last Things, never fear! The Procession to Calvary is set in the same world as Four Last Things, and features a few recurring characters, but the story can be played independently. If, however, you do want to catch up before you start, Four Last Things is also on sale for the next week, at 50% off!

Don't say I'm not good to you.

:)

Joe
